**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (no auto-renewal mechanic).**

- Clause 18.1 (p0228) creates one 25-year Initial Period from the RFS Date; thereafter the Agreement continues and is terminable "by agreement of the Parties." Clause 18.2 requires unanimous written agreement to terminate during the Initial Period, and 18.3 makes post-Initial-Period decommissioning a two-thirds voting-interest decision.
- Searches for renewal, extension, initial period, and price/cost-increase language returned no automatic-renewal clause, no renewal term length, no non-renewal notice window and no renewal uplift mechanic — so every conditional element at both levels is inapplicable, and continuation-by-agreement sits at or above the preferred "mutual agreement" position.
- The one year's prior written notice in 18.1 is our own unilateral exit right (at the end of, or any time after, the Initial Period), not a condition on continuation; it benefits us, so it is not treated as a >90-day non-renewal window and is not double-flagged under the termination rules.
- No redline proposed; noted only in the rationale that there is no renewal pricing to cap.
